Join us as we go behind the scenes with Deep Field Games (Abiotic Factor) and Vaulted Sky Games (Midnight Ghost Hunt)—indie teams that have successfully launched and supported live games with active player communities—as they share how they built and shipped the online systems behind their live player experiences.

Check out other exclusive Indie Games Week interviews and Inside Unreal episodes packed with dev tips for small teams here: unrealengine.com/events/indie-games-week-2026

To find out more about building indie games with Unreal Engine, take a look at our website: unrealengine.com/uses/indie-games
title: Abiotic Factor & Midnight Ghost Hunt: Online Systems w/ Epic Online Services | Indie Games Week 2026

author: Unreal Engine
description:
Watch this video to find out how 40 indie devs handcrafted ‘Out of Words’, a heartfelt co-op adventure built in UE5—blending stop motion and physics-defying puzzles using Nanite, Lumen, and more.

Developed in Denmark by the small teams at Kong Orange and WiredFly, ‘Out of Words’ is a co-op platformer adventure. Together with a friend via online cross-platform or couch co-op, players explore the wild, colorful realm of Vokabulantis as Kurt and Karla in a story about the first time they held hands.

Read our full interview and explore how the game’s stunning visuals were lovingly crafted by hand and brought to life in Unreal Engine 5 by a team of puppet makers, programmers, and poets: https://epic.gm/dev-interviews-out-of-words
